attchmntText: Kusumgar Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Resultsfor the Quarter and Half-Year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Kusumgar Limited published newspaper advertisements on November 7, 2026, regarding its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 5, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue from operations was 91,708 crore, with a profit for the period of 7,533 crore. Standalone revenue from operations was 35,369 crore, with a standalone profit for the period of 5,132 crore. Earnings per share were 33.93 basic and 33.85 diluted on a consolidated basis. ESDS Software Solution Limited issued a notice for its 21st Annual General Meeting to be held on November 30, 2026, via video conferencing. Remote e-voting is available from November 26, 2026, to November 29, 2026. IG Petrochemicals Limited published advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
